title: FROM HOMEOSTASIS TO RESOURCE SHARING: BIOLOGICALLY AND ECONOMICALLY ALIGNED MULTI-OBJECTIVE MULTI-AGENT GRIDWORLD-BASED AI SAFETY BENCHMARKS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its benchmarks focus on AI safety themes aligned with biology and economics, such as homeostasis, diminishing returns, sustainability, and resource sharing in a multi-agent gridworld environment.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
